Recall that the equation of an ellipsoid centered at $O$ is given by

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{{c}^{2}}=1,
$$

and an ellipsoid centered at $({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})$ is given by

$$
\frac{(x-{x}_{0})^{2}}{{a}^{2}}+\frac{(y-{y}_{0})^{2}}{{b}^{2}}+\frac{(z-{z}_{0})^{2}}{{c}^{2}}=1,
$$

Thus, our equation is an ellipsoid with the following parameters:

$$
({x}_{0},{y}_{0},{z}_{0})=(1,-2,0),\,a=3,\,b=\sqrt{7},\,c=2.
$$
